bioconda.name: r-recetox-waveica
bioconda.summary: Removal of batch effects for large-scale untargeted metabolomics data based on wavelet transform.
bioconda.description: Recetox-waveica is a fork of WaveICA package customized by RECETOX. This package is used to remove batch effects from large-scale untargeted metabolomics data and contains functionality of both original WaveICA and WaveICA 2.0 libraries.
